name: feedback_id
description: Unique identifier for the feedback entry.

name: sentiment
description: Sentiment classification of the feedback (e.g., positive, negative, neutral).

name: confidence
description: Confidence score of the sentiment analysis.

name: is_positive
description: Indicates if the sentiment is positive.

name: is_neutral
description: Indicates if the sentiment is neutral.

name: created_at
description: Timestamp when the feedback Sentiment was created.

name: updated_at
description: Timestamp when the feedback Sentiment was last updated.
